Frequently Asked Questions
Is the summer exhibit included with admission?Yes. The exhibit is included with regular museum admission.
Will there be special programming?Yes. Additional programming and special activities will be announced soon.
What ages is this exhibit best for?The exhibit is designed for children ages 2–9 and their families.
Do children need art experience to participate?No. This is an open-ended, play-based experience where children can explore creativity at their own pace.
Will it be messy?Yes. This exhibit encourages hands-on creativity, so we recommend dressing children in clothes that can get messy.
Are you open on Mondays?No. Pretend City is closed on Mondays, except for Memorial Day and Labor Day.
Why does the exhibit close early?The exhibit closes at 3:00 pm to allow time for cleaning and resetting the space. The museum remains open until 4:00 pm.

events.title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.display_title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.description:
This summer, Pretend City Children’s Museum teamed up with OC Waste & Recycling to bring hands-on vermicomposting education to young learners! ♻️🪱🌱 Through interactive presentations and activities, kids explore how worms help recycle food scraps into nutrient-rich compost, learning firsthand how small actions can make a big impact for our planet! Together, we’re making organics recycling fun, engaging, and accessible for the next generation of environmental stewards. 
Time: 10 am  
Included with museum admission 
Activities take place throughout the day while supplies last. 
*Events and times are subject to change.
About the play partner: OC Waste & Recycling serves the County’s solid waste disposal needs by providing waste management services, operating public landfills, protecting the local environment, investing in renewable energy enterprises and promoting recycling in order to ensure a safe and healthy community for current and future generations. OCWR also provides education, outreach, and sustainability programs that help residents reduce waste and support state and local mandates. 
 
Frequently Asked Questions 
What is Getting Wiggly with Composting program? 
Getting Wiggly with Composting is a hands-on environmental learning experience at Pretend City Children’s Museum in Irvine, California, where children discover how worms turn food scraps into nutrient-rich compost through vermicomposting. 
Is this activity included with admission?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families. 
Will kids see real worms?
Yes. Children can learn about real worms and how they help break down food scraps into compost. 
Are there other days to attend this program?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities will take place on June 6, June 16, June 23, and June 30 from 10 am – 2 pm while supplies last.

events.title: Cookbook Author: Jeffrey Eisner
events.description:
Join us at the Aliso Viejo Library for a cooking demonstration with Jeffrey Eisner! Limited complimentary books available, while supplies last. No registration required, all ages welcome. Early arrival suggested.

Jeffrey Eisner is a multiple-time #1 bestselling author where his debut cookbook was one of the most sold during the 2020 pandemic - a time when people were cooking at home more than ever. His trusted and signature recipes earned him numerous repeat appearances on television shows such as Rachael Ray, Good Morning America, and The Food Network. He develops and tests his recipes based on his travels with some of his native New York flair tossed into the mix. When not cooking, he enjoys spoiling his dog, Banjo the Norwich Terrier. He also loves theatre and pinball. Check him out at pressureluckcooking.com and on the various social media platforms.

For more information, call 949-360-1730 or email ocpl.alisoviejo@occr.ocgov.com

This project is funded in part through a grant from the California Department of Aging and administered locally by the Orange County Office on Aging.

events.description:

Times:  11 am & 2:30 pm
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
Included with museum admission 
About Play Partner: Mike Alfaro is a Creative Director, Content Creator, and Children’s Book Writer with over 400k followers on social media (@millennialloteria). Recognized as one of TikTok’s 2023 Latinx Visionary Voices, he also earned a spot in the inaugural class of the LA Time’s 2022 Vanguardia List—celebrating Latino innovators, instigators, and power players breaking through barriers. Originally from Guatemala, he now resides in Los Angeles with his wife Amy and baby Mya. 
Gerardo Guillén is a Mexican-American Creative Director and Illustrator born in El Paso, Texas. He has created award-winning advertising campaigns for clients like McDonald’s, Fiji, Honda, and Jack in the Box. (Portfolio: ElArtDirector.com) His work has been profiled by PBS, NPR, Communication Arts, and more. He now lives in Los Angeles with his wife Gina, his sons Oli and Max. 
Books will be available for purchase during the event.
Space may be limited. 
*Events and times are subject to change. 
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this event included with museum admission?
Yes. The program is included with regular museum admission. 
Will books be available for purchase?
Yes. Copies of ¡Gooool!: A Soccer Book for Kids will be available for purchase during the event.

Yes. Families will have the opportunity to meet the creators and participate in a book signing after the program.

events.title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.display_title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.description:
This summer, Pretend City Children’s Museum teamed up with OC Waste & Recycling to bring hands-on vermicomposting education to young learners! ♻️🪱🌱 Through interactive presentations and activities, kids explore how worms help recycle food scraps into nutrient-rich compost, learning firsthand how small actions can make a big impact for our planet! Together, we’re making organics recycling fun, engaging, and accessible for the next generation of environmental stewards. 
Time: 10 am  
Included with museum admission 
Activities take place throughout the day while supplies last. 
*Events and times are subject to change.
About the play partner: OC Waste & Recycling serves the County’s solid waste disposal needs by providing waste management services, operating public landfills, protecting the local environment, investing in renewable energy enterprises and promoting recycling in order to ensure a safe and healthy community for current and future generations. OCWR also provides education, outreach, and sustainability programs that help residents reduce waste and support state and local mandates. 
 
Frequently Asked Questions 
What is Getting Wiggly with Composting program? 
Getting Wiggly with Composting is a hands-on environmental learning experience at Pretend City Children’s Museum in Irvine, California, where children discover how worms turn food scraps into nutrient-rich compost through vermicomposting. 
Is this activity included with admission?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families. 
Will kids see real worms?
Yes. Children can learn about real worms and how they help break down food scraps into compost. 
Are there other days to attend this program?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities will take place on June 6, June 16, June 23, and June 30 from 10 am – 2 pm while supplies last.

events.title: Celebrating Juneteenth
events.description:
Celebrate Freedom and Culture this Juneteenth, a historic day marking freedom and resilience. Children will learn about the significance of Juneteenth through storytelling, and music and movement.
Celebrate culture, community, and history with us and don’t miss this vibrant celebration of freedom and unity. 
TIMES: 11 am – Chantrell M. Lewis
2:30 pm – UFirst Artist
About the play partner: 
Jar of Sunshine is an organization dedicated to creating accessibility to the arts, literacy and wellness. 
Deborah Jane is a writer and producer who helps children discover the joy of storytelling through writing, rhythm, and creative expression. As the founder of House of Deborah Jane Studios and the facilitator of UFirst Artist’s, she brings her professional experience in writing and producing stories for stage, film, and television into playful learning spaces where young voices are celebrated. 
UFirst Artist is a creative learning company that uses writing, music, movement, and storytelling to help children express themselves with confidence and care for others. Through playful, age-appropriate arts experiences, UFirst Artist nurtures creativity, community, and young voices in spaces where every child is seen, valued, and encouraged to share their story. 
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now. 
*Members do not require a reservation.
